opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low‑income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland (or have a substantial connection), not eligible for public tuition fee funding, enrolled on an undergraduate degree at a Scottish Institute of Higher Education, and meeting household income thresholds.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,820 per year to cover tuition fees for eligible undergraduate students from low‑income Scottish households studying at Scottish universities or colleges.
